description: This file defines a React custom hook `useSocket` that manages a WebSocket connection using Socket.IO. It handles connection lifecycle, environment configuration, subscription to events, and message emission. Designed for frontend React applications to facilitate real-time communication with a backend server.

methods.name: useSocket(namespace = '/')
methods.description: A React hook that creates and manages a Socket.IO client connection, providing connection status, event subscription, and emission capabilities.
